name: Special Module in Machine Learning
description: Will cover some specialised and emerging theme in machine learning research or practice, which may evolve with time as per the latest trends and interests. Examples as of now may include the interface of information theory and deep learning; the relevance of statistical physics ideas to understanding emergent behaviours in machine learning systems; specialised deep learning architectures for particular tasks or data sets, etc.
